theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fcd_imp_piece_orientation_sign
theorems.statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (G : Euclid k → Euclid N) (B : Set (Euclid k)) (L : NNReal) (κ : ℝ), μHE[k] R.carrier ≠ ∞ → LipschitzWith L G → MeasurableSet B → 0 < κ → (∀ a ∈ B, ∀ a' ∈ B, κ * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖G a - G a'‖) → (∀ a ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ G a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ G a)) → G '' B ⊆ R.carrier → ∃ s : Euclid k → ℝ, Measurable s ∧ (∀ u, s u = 1 ∨ s u = -1) ∧ ∀ᵐ u ∂(volume.restrict B), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid N) k, Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin k => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ))))) * R.orient (G u) α = s u * α (fun a => fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ)))
